title: SYNC-01 Preserve deadline lease and request identity

A single propagated 270-second attempt deadline SHALL cover extraction 40, mapping 70, audit 70, feedback 40 and at least five seconds for persistence. API write/proxy/browser timeouts SHALL be 285/300/310 seconds. At most one transport retry per request budget is permitted, with no JSON repair loop or background recovery.
